CAMEL-22654.title: camel-jbang - Add command for loading and adding new routes from source files
CAMEL-22654.description:
When you have an existing running camel app, you may want to dynamic add more routes to it via a camel jbang command

 

camel cmd add-source --source=myroutes.yaml myapp

 

But what should the name of the command be? Its hard to come up with a good name.

commits.message: CAMEL-22654: camel-jbang - Add command for loading and adding new routes from source files
commits.author: davsclaus

CAMEL-22687.title: camel-jbang - Always trace last message
CAMEL-22687.description:
It would be nice to always just trace last message, and then make it easy to show a summary of the last message, so the end user can help understand what happened.

The camel trace command can do that, but we may want some kind of quick summary, that just shows the route path / source code EIPs or whatnot. And then allow to make it interactive where you can use go forward / back and see what happended.

commits.message: CAMEL-22687: camel-jbang - get history to show latest completed exchange message history.
commits.author: davsclaus
